bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" --format 'image={{.Image}} restart={{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}} compose_project={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} compose_service={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}} workdir={{.Config.WorkingDir}}'
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; const s=readFileSync("/opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs","utf8"); console.log("PUBLISHER_PAID_CHECK",s.match(/const paidResult=[\\s\\S]{0,420}/)?.[0]||"UNKNOWN")'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '^gace-createvdobot-'
